meta.title: Assign items of one PR from the list

steps.note: Enable the required team-filtering configuration for the PR list.
Open the Purchase Requisitions screen where the PR items are assigned.
Stay on the Open tab containing PR-1.

args.goal: Search for PR-1, select all 3 of its line items, click the Assign control beside Upload PRs, choose Food Buyer (User A) from the Search a user list, and stop with all 3 rows showing User A in the Assignee column and the assignment success message visible.

steps.note: Perform the PR-list-specific bulk assignment and verify the assigned rows on screen.
Assert the expected success message was shown after assigning the three items.
